entities.name: Ethyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The reactant contains an ethyl ester CCOC(=O)–CH2–, while the product contains the corresponding carboxylic acid HOOC–CH2–.
The principal transformation is ester saponification; no oxidation, reduction, or ring-forming change is indicated.
Atom mapping is consistent with cleavage of the ester alkoxy C–O bond and implicit proton transfer.

entities.name: LiOH aqueous THF saponification
observations: Matching ORD records report lithium hydroxide under aqueous conditions with THF as solvent; ethanol and water are also present in the recorded mixture.
The isolated yield was reported as 30%.
An acidic workup is chemically expected to furnish the free carboxylic acid, but the specific acid was not established.
No separate catalyst, oxidant, or reductant was reported; time and temperature were not specified.
